title: Adventure Playsets Recalls Swing Sets - Detaching Frames Pose Fall Hazard
summary: Defective bolts could cause the swing set frame to detach from the fort structure, posing a fall hazard to the user. Units: About 26,000.

title: American Innovations Corp. Recalls Ladder Extensions that Can Detach and Hit Consumers
summary: If the knob securing the extension unit to the ladder is not tight, it can detach and fall when the ladder is being removed or lowered. The unit could hit a bystander, causing serious head injuries. Units: About 750.

title: Hoshino USA Inc. Recalls to Repair Electric Bass
summary: If the battery is improperly installed, the bass can overheat, causing internal damage and a fire hazard. Units: About 700.

title: Juicy Couture Children's Jewelry Recalled for Lead Poisoning Hazard
summary: The recalled jewelry contains high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 2,800.

title: Masterfoods USA Recalls M&M'S® Menorah for Fire Hazard
summary: If a candle burns all the way down, the plastic Menorah could ignite and present a fire hazard. Units: About 1,008.

title: Bicycle Child Carriers Recalled Due to Fall Hazard
summary: If the seat is not fully seated on the rack, the plastic guide tabs on the carrier can break. If these tabs break, it could cause the seat to fall off. This poses a risk of serious injury to a child seated in the carrier. Units: About 14,000.

title: Mini Fireplace Candle Kits Recalled for Fire Hazard
summary: The mini fireplace, which houses the candle, can ignite, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 78,500.

title: Metal Charms Sold with Twentieth Century Fox DVDs Recalled for Toxic Lead Hazard
summary: The recalled charms contain high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 730,000.

title: Regal Lager Inc. Recall to Repair Phil & Teds Twin Strollers
summary: The plastic hinge on the handlebar can crack or break, causing the handlebar to detach while in use. This poses a risk of injury to young children. Units: About 425.

title: Slingshots Recalled by Daisy Manufacturing Due to Risk of Serious Eye Injury
summary: If the slingshot band slips out of its frame during use, the ball at the end of the tubing can strike the user, resulting in serious facial injuries. Units: About 104,500.

title: Trek Recalls Anthem C Elite Bicycle Helmets for Failing Impact Standards
summary: Product testing has demonstrated that these helmets do not comply with CPSC safety standards for impact resistance. Consumers could suffer impact head injuries in a fall. Units: About 4,500.

title: First Alert® Smoke Alarms and Combination Smoke/CO Alarms Recalled for Rapidly Draining Battery Power
summary: These alarms can drain the power from batteries rapidly, causing premature low battery power. Consumers will be alerted to the low battery power and the need to replace the battery by a chirping of the unit. title: Toy Phones Recalled for Choking Hazard
summary: The push buttons on the toy phone can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 6,000.

title: Yamaha In-Ceiling and In-Wall Speakers Recalled After Reports of Units Falling
summary: On some speakers, the mounting clamps can break causing the speaker to fall. Falling speakers could possibly hit consumers. Units: About 4,300 units.

title: Baby 2 Pack Pacifiers Recalled for Choking Hazard
summary: The pacifier's nipple can easily detach from the guard, posing a serious choking hazard to young children. Units: About 3,600 packages of two pacifiers.

title: Lighted Mirror Sold at Wal-Mart Recalled for Shock Hazard
summary: Exposed wires inside the mirror could pose an electrical shock hazard to the user, when they touch the mirror. Units: About 110,000.

title: Arctic Cat Inc. Announces Recall of Off-Highway Utility Vehicles
summary: The rear brake caliper used on these units could leak brake fluid, resulting in reduced braking ability at the rear wheels. The front wheel brakes are unaffected by this condition. Units: About 2,120.

title: Light Fixtures Recalled After Reports of Units Falling
summary: Two nuts in a mounting mechanism of these light fixtures were not attached. The fixture could detach, fall and possibly hit consumers. Units: About 1,100 units.

title: Tyco Fire & Security Recall to Upgrade Software of Fire Detection Systems
summary: Sensors in these fire detection systems could experience reduced sensitivity to smoke in conditions of high humidity and high temperature. If this occurs, these sensors could delay detecting the presence of smoke in the event of a fire. Units: About 128,000 Fire Detection Systems.

title: Tyco Fire & Security Recalls Smoke Detectors for Replacement
summary: The smoke detectors could experience reduced sensitivity to smoke in conditions of high humidity and high temperature. If this occurs, these detectors could delay detecting the presence of smoke in the event of a fire. Units: About 128,000 smoke detectors.

title: Hunting Tree Stands Recalled for Collapse Hazard
summary: The j-hook attachment of the tree strap can fail, which can cause the tree stand to collapse. Consumers using these stands could fall and suffer serious injuries or death. Units: About 6,700.

title: IKEA Recalls Candles for Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The candle's wax can catch fire causing a high flame and posing a fire and burn hazard. Units: About 133,000 packages of six candles.

title: Rainbow Play Systems Recalls Swing Seats for Fall Hazard
summary: These swing seats can unexpectedly break in half, causing the users to fall to the ground. Units: About 18,400.

title: Aqua-Leisure Industries Recalls Inflatable Pool Ladders for Fall Hazard
summary: The plastic step support clips can be assembled upside down, causing the ladder steps to break under a user's weight. Units: About 320,000.

title: Masterbuilt Manufacturing Inc. Recalls Electric Smokers for Fire Hazard
summary: Smoldering wood chips used in the wood chip box can ignite into flames when the door of the unit is opened, posing a risk of burn injuries to users and property damage to nearby combustibles. Units: About 10,700.
